readings: Counter initializes to 0 at power-up, so tc is asserted (1) before any load.
Counter has no defined initial value; tc is unknown/X until the first load, or the counter may start at an arbitrary value and decrement from it.
tc is combinational (tc = (counter == 0)), changing in the same cycle the counter updates after a clock edge.
tc is registered, updating only on the next clock edge, so it asserts one cycle after the counter reaches 0.
Loading data=0 with load=1 makes tc assert immediately in the same cycle (0-cycle timeout).
Loading data=0 with load=1 makes tc assert only after the next clock edge (1-cycle timeout).
